CAF.note: No link between the civil register and an ID system stated.

facts.fact: Oubangui Médias reports that the MODERO steering committee, meeting on 17 November 2026, named the civil-status management software MbetiNet and adopted a function for collecting civil-status data in the platform and app, with 130,000 acts digitised in January-September 2026.

CAF.note: No ID number at birth stated.
No local government office connection stated.
The steering committee is a project body, not a consultation on a digital law or policy.

facts.fact: Oubangui Médias says the MODERO civil-registration project is financed by the European Union and implemented by CIVIPOL with the DGDEC.
Oubangui Médias says the MODERO steering committee validated a new roadmap on 17 November 2026 and that the project runs until 2028.
